tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swasti/ rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dkar chag thog mar/

(ka)pa la/ gang las byung ba brgyud pa'i rim pa'i rnam thar lo rgyus ni/ mnga' bdag nyang rin po che'i gter byon gu ru'i rnam thar zangs gling ma/ de'i don bsdus gsol 'debs nyang ral nyid kyis mdzad pa/ mdzad pa bcu gcig gi gsol 'debs ratna gling pas mdzad pa bcas la ldeb/ 95 1-190 jo nang rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i slob dpon padma'i rnam thar rgya gar lugs la ldeb/ 22 191-234 gu ru'i rnam thar bka' thang don bsdus gsol 'debs u dumba ra'i phreng mdzes la ldeb/ 10 235-254 padma gar dbang 'chi med bstan gnyis gling pa'i gter byon gu ru'i rnam thar rdo rje'i rgyan phreng la ldeb/ 11 255-275 bai ro'i rnam thar padma'i dga' tshal la ldeb/ 32 277-340 grub thob gter ston rim par byon pa rnams kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus bkod pa rin chen bai ḍūrya'i phreng ba la ldeb/ 213 341-765 de'i don bsdus gsol 'debs rgyas pa la ldeb/ 14 767-794 mtshan sdom gsol 'debs bsdus pa la ldeb/ 4 795-802 mkhyen brtse'i rnam thar gsol 'debs bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs gu ṇa'i gsung dharma ma tis zhal skong can la ldeb/ 4 803-810 mchog gling rnam thar gsol 'debs bkra shis 'khyil pa'i dbyangs snyan la ldeb/ 3 811-816 'jam mgon rnam thar gsol 'debs zhal gsung ma kun tu bzang po'i sgra dbyangs dang bdag bstod bcas la ldeb/ 3 817-822 bcas bzhugs so// //
